note: Percentile bands are computed over the trailing ten years of the as-published (point-in-time) series and are frozen here before the state runs. A state is descriptive: it names where the curve or a spread sits in its own history and implies no rate or spread direction.

bands.desc: slope below its 10th percentile over ten years

credit.method: option-adjusted spread (OAS) series — IG BAMLC0A0CM, HY BAMLH0A0HYM2 — which are duration-controlled by construction; NOT an ETF price ratio

bands.desc: below the 20th percentile over ten years

rates_regime.label: DIAGNOSTIC

logic.when: HY or IG credit state is stressed

logic.note: inverted curves have historically preceded rate declines — an association, not a prediction

logic.when: curve state is normal or steep and credit is not stressed

rates_regime.gate: Gated as DIAGNOSTIC until the pre-registered fixed-income retirement test (rates-regime state vs static duration) passes on the method of the regime retirement test. Drives no sizing. Do not execute on this value.
